note: Codex must inspect the current files before applying these changes and preserve any user work.

rules: Fetch origin/main before selecting the base.
Create a new integration branch and separate worktree before any repository modification.
Never switch, edit, commit, merge, or push from the main worktree.
If the audited commit is an ancestor of origin/main, perform a targeted delta audit from the audited commit to origin/main.
If the audited commit is not an ancestor, stop product implementation and report that the repository map requires revalidation.
Use the first available integration branch name: agent/skys-limit-convex-os, then -2, -3, and so on.
Use at most two worker worktrees concurrently, created from the current integration branch.
Worker branches must have disjoint file/resource locks.
Integrate verified worker commits into the integration branch, then rerun the batch gate.
Open one PR from the integration branch to main after all permitted gates pass.
